title: Damn Vulnerable DeFi
description: Eighteen vulnerable DeFi challenges by The Red Guild (flash loans, price oracles, governance, NFTs, DEXs, lending pools, smart contract wallets, timelocks, vaults, meta-transactions, upgradeability), each solved by writing a Foundry test that exploits the contracts as the player account. Runs as a workbench with Foundry and the challenges built.
question: Solve the Damn Vulnerable DeFi challenges: make each challenge's Foundry test pass.
